editorial.blurb: A cheerful, family-run diner serving Filipino and American breakfast classics with real care—the kind of place where the owner remembers you.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the Chicken and Waffles early in the day before the rush; they fry to order which takes time, but it's worth it. Arrive before peak weekend hours to avoid the lengthy waits.

topDishes.note: Super tasty with perfectly balanced pickles, rice, and eggs
Incredibly good fried chicken, worth the wait
Perfectly crisp potatoes, caramelized peppers, just the right amount of chorizo
